author: UnrealIsBAD
quote:
This is WAR!
The good reviews are most likely rockstar bots and fanboys. I couldn’t even get a refund, that says enough about their practices. They knew the game wouldn’t sell so they mislead us and tricked us into buying.
The game’s entirety is ****!
They say it gets better later on, but it’s only “better” compared to the extreme **** parts of the game.  It’s not good.
If you got bugs or crashes you get made fun of because the almighty gta is perfect.
There’s no story, zero, I repeat, no story. There’s not one mission you’ll remember , except that you get forced to have gay sex , you’ll remember that disgusting thing for the rest of your life.
30fps is no no, it’s not even 30 when things get interesting, a few more enemies or cars moving  you’re going sub 20.
There’s no gameplay system , the good is gone and the bad is worse. No crime allowed by the game like it used to, yes you can commit crime but you gotta be a good citizen or you get a bad ending. 
I don’t wanna continue, it’s been a waste time and money
